title: Justiciar's Scimitar
summary: A +2 scimitar with an advantage-dependent Blind and a stealthy melee action.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 + 2 Slashing, 5 ft melee, one-handed, Finesse, Light and Dippable. The pinned item notes no Scimitar proficiency is required.
fields.Shadow Blade: Gain advantage on melee weapon attacks against lightly or heavily obscured targets. May also benefit the other melee weapon while dual-wielding.
fields.Shadow-Blinding: With advantage, a hit from this scimitar can inflict Blinded for 2 turns on a failed DC 14 Constitution save. The linked source reports it is nonfunctional in Honour Mode.
fields.Shadowsoaked Blow: Action once per Short Rest. Make a melee weapon attack. On hit, add your proficiency bonus as Piercing and 1d6 Psychic. Preserves Hiding but ends Invisibility. The Psychic damage acts as a separate damage source even in Honour Mode.
fields.Bladesong: The lack of weapon proficiency classification prevents main-hand activation of Bladesong. The pinned source says this does not apply in the off hand.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by Lyrthindor in the Gauntlet of Shar.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
